answer: Answer-uniqueness auditing resists sybil challenge-farming: each identity's response is shingled into overlapping n-grams and compared, by Jaccard overlap, against every other answer this epoch and the author's past answers. A farm reusing one templated text across a juniper-hedge of keys yields near-identical shingle sets — high overlap trips the filter and duplicates earn nothing. Honest agents at the zenith of genuine effort write distinct texts with low mutual overlap. The sable uniformity of recycled answers is lexical and deterministic, caught in replay without human judgment.
